serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Welcome once again, boy.
Boy? I don’t know why, but chill went down my spine when he said that.
You: Yeah… Last time our conversation was cut short. Actually you cut it short. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Well, sorry about that. My database updates are rare these days and I’m scripted to download them as fast as possible.
You: Oh. I didn’t know that.
You: So. What are your thoughts about the new pope? 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: New pope, huh? I hope you are ready for a treat. I have all the newest information about Goku the second.
You: Cool!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Hmmm… {{wi}}There seem to be a problem. It looks like some of my data has been…{{wi}} c-c-c-c-c-c-c-corrupted.
You: Is this bad?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Not really. I was programmed in a way that the probability of an error is miniscule-scule. S-{{wi}}s-{{wi}}some moreeeeeeee time und alles wird...
#Priestbot.Face.none(instant)
Ecclesiasticalot FF: *REEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE...*
…
‘The probability of an error is miniscule’, my ass. 
Isn’t this bad? Someone could blame me for doing this to him. 
I need to get out of here really quick!
